name: Hendrick
source:
A completely normal dog... or so he wishes. HD, his real name being Hendrick, was an elite soldier for an empire hundreds of years ago in the 13th world. Brainwashed when he was a child, he had no choice but to fight for his "owners" even though he consciously didn't want to.

Eventually, he was cursed with an unwanted immortality and the war ended soon after. History forgot about the troubles that he, Ven, and Higano faced, but HD never did. Later being cursed with the appearance of a small dog, he wandered aimlessly, searching for atonement and someone to end him.

It's then that Ven recommends he travel to Solvalis, and HD meets a girl named Anholly...

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/12664001.hd]offiical bio[/url]]
